comment: src/HSV2RGB.cpp at commit b90cd69, with applyScaleOffset and hsvToRgb in src/Utility.cpp. All three outputs take as many channels as the widest input patched, and at least one. Only the hue is wrapped back into range; saturation and value are handed to hsvToRgb unclamped, so a scale and offset that push them past 1 produce voltages above 10V and below 0V at the outputs. The panel prints HSV over the three input jacks and RGB under the three output jacks and names none of the six trimpots.
